samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulator module that accumulates 4 8-bit input data and outputs the result.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="ACCUMULATE_COUNT" value="4">Number of inputs to accumulate.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="accumulator" width="10">Accumulated sum register.</reg>
        <reg id="count" width="2">Count of valid inputs received.</reg>
        <reg id="valid_out_reg">Register for valid_out signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                accumulator <= 10'b0;
                count <= 2'b0;
                valid_out_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (valid_in && count < ACCUMULATE_COUNT) begin
                    accumulator <= accumulator + data_in;
                    count <= count + 1;
                end
                if (count == ACCUMULATE_COUNT) begin
                    valid_out_reg <= 1'b1;
                    count <= 2'b0;
                end else begin
                    valid_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
        data_out <= accumulator;
        valid_out <= valid_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
